summaries.summary: A 19-year-old was arrested in Illinois for planning a mass shooting at a Hindu temple, which was thwarted when his rifle jammed. The incident drew attention from various media and responses from India regarding the swift action taken.

Figma announced new features for its platform and launched code layers in open beta. Apple introduced the HomeView tablet and new apps, while Epic Games revealed a new launcher for its games, claiming improved speed.
Three Indian nationals were killed in a building fire in Germany, with a resident arrested under suspicion of murder. This incident highlights ongoing safety concerns in residential areas.

The DMRC submitted an affidavit to the Supreme Court claiming that recent protests have led to a reduction in metro traffic. The case also involves hearings concerning previous detentions during protests.

Intero Biosystems is innovating drug testing alternatives by providing lab-grown human intestines as substitutes for animal testing, aiming to help drug manufacturers align with evolving regulatory demands.
The announcement of a new expansion pass for Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave includes the launch of Wave 1, generating buzz among fans of the game franchise.
